#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Modulo {
public:
    long long mod;
    Modulo(long long m) : mod(m) {}

    long long plus(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) c -= mod;
        return c;
    }
    long long minus(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = a - b;
        if(c < 0) c += mod;
        return c;
    }
    long long times(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % mod;
    }
    long long pow(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if (b & 1) c = (c * a) % mod;
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }
    long long div(long long a, long long b) {
        return times(a, pow(b, mod - 2));
    }
    long long factorial(int n) {
        long long f = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f = (f * i) % mod;
        }
        return f;
    }
    std::vector<long long> factorials(int n) {
        std::vector<long long> f(n+1);
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = (f[i-1] * i) % mod;
        }
        return f;
    }
    long long combination(int n, int k, const std::vector<long long>& factorials) {
        return div(factorials[n], times(factorials[k], factorials[n - k]));
    }
    long long combination(int n, int k) {
        std::vector<long long> facts = factorials(n);
        return combination(n, k, facts);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    long long kt;
    cin >> n >> kt;

    if (kt >= n) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int k = static_cast<int>(kt);
    Modulo mod(998244353);
    std::vector<long long> facts = mod.factorials(n);
    long long ans = 0;
    int c = n - k;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
        long long t = mod.times(mod.combination(c, i, facts), mod.pow(c - i, n));
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            ans = mod.plus(ans, t);
        } else {
            ans = mod.minus(ans, t);
        }
    }
    ans = mod.times(ans, mod.combination(n, n - k, facts));
    if (k > 0) ans = mod.times(ans, 2);
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
